project_type: Python 3.13 CLI application (single package 'hotline'), stdlib-first, no runtime third-party deps on core paths
language: Python (target >=3.13; local interpreter is 3.14.7 so avoid 3.14-only features; invoke via uv run / python3)
build_system: uv 0.12.16 (installed at ~/.local/bin/uv) manages the venv and deps; setuptools build backend declared in pyproject.toml; uv.lock MUST be generated via `uv lock` and committed
test_framework: pytest (declared as a dev dependency, installed via uv sync)
build_command: uv venv && uv sync   (use `uv sync --extra audio` to also install faster-whisper)
verification_instructions: 1) `uv run ruff check .` clean; 2) `uv run ruff format --check .` clean; 3) `uv run pytest` all pass; 4) `uv run python -m hotline once --dry-run` exits 0 and prints detections offline against fixtures/. Keep uv.lock committed and in sync (`uv lock`). If uv is missing in an environment, install via `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh` or `pip install uv`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock is generated by `uv lock` and MUST be committed and kept in sync whenever pyproject.toml dependencies change. No other generated/snapshot files.
environment_constraints: Tests MUST NOT hit the network: all HTTP/fetch/robots/sender/transcriber I/O is injectable and tests use fixtures only. No secrets in code or committed files (secrets come from env vars only). Polite configurable User-Agent on all real HTTP; respect robots.txt before fetching. faster-whisper import must be lazy and degrade gracefully when missing.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/steering files exist (repo has only LICENSE + .git on branch main). Work directly on main, greenfield, no worktree. MIT licensed (c) 2026 lgf2111. Commit locally per feature; never push.
key_patterns: Injection-by-callable: each source/notify takes an optional callable (fetch, robots_checker, transcriber, post/sender) defaulting to the real stdlib implementation; tests pass fakes. Frozen dataclasses for typed records. PEP 604 unions (str | None). Docstrings on all public modules/classes/functions. ruff line-length 100, rules E,F,I,UP,B.
relevant_files: pyproject.toml (project metadata, extras audio/dev, [project.scripts] hotline=hotline.cli:main, ruff + pytest config)
hotline/detect.py (Detection dataclass, score_text, detect; scoring ruleset)
tests/conftest.py + tests/test_*.py (detect, store, web, config, notify, social, audio, cli)
directory_structure: hotline/ (package: cli.py, config.py, store.py, detect.py, notify.py, __init__.py, __main__.py, sources/ with __init__.py+web.py+social.py+audio.py); tests/ (pytest suite + conftest.py); fixtures/ (3 HTML pages + 1 transcript); repo root holds pyproject.toml, uv.lock, config.example.toml, .env.example, README.md, Makefile, LICENSE, .github/workflows/ci.yml. Full file-by-file plan at .agents/tasks/plan.md.
